# Start the debug Wi-Fi network

Fills the Wi-Fi request block and starts the open debug network and user shell.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x6122e9f6` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Reached from the card settings file (property 0xF971) after startup, a method documented for the PEN-F by Olympus firmware research (oly_fw_analysis). The network has no password.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): E-M5 III 1.7 addresses of the card-file path traced, following the PEN-F analysis in oly_fw_analysis. Source: [Stock Wi-Fi debug shell](../sources/em5n.wifi-shell.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): A card file on stock E-M5 III 1.7 started the network and the shell answered on port 23. Source: [Stock Wi-Fi debug shell](../sources/em5n.wifi-shell.md).
